title: Howdy Nashville
description:
Stay in a renovated historic East Nashville home! Enjoy privacy with a separate wing, private entrance, bath, and laundry room. Relax in the shared backyard or patio. Great location just 2 miles from downtown Broadway, and walking distance to great restaurants such as Folk, Xia Bao, Redheaded Stranger, Audrey and more. Experience comfort with a hint of history!

TN permit #CASR2023045944

Guest access
You’ll enjoy complete privacy with your own entrance from the backyard, as well as a fully private bedroom, bathroom, and laundry room—perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring Music City. PLEASE NOTE: We do live in the front part of the home. Though the two spaces are completely separated by a locked pocket door, you may hear us in the front part of the house, the kitchen etc. For best sound proofing, you can close the bedroom door. 

The only shared space is the backyard, which you are welcome to use.

Other things to note
You may spot our two super-friendly cats in the yard during your stay. They’re orange and white and look like twins, but you can tell them apart: Cowboy is the chubby 2-year-old, while Allstar is our big, lovable 16-year-old. Rest assured, they are NOT allowed inside the Airbnb. However, if you’re a cat lover, they’d be delighted to get some pets!

Our house sits under large beautiful black walnut trees. You may hear large walnuts hit the roof.
